photos.title: Oceanfront houses with backyard pools in Surfside Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: A stretch of oceanfront in the Town of Surfside Beach seen from a plane over the ocean: four three-story beach houses in a row, each with a small fenced pool between the house and the dunes and a wooden walkway over the dunes to the beach; a three-story condo building with its own pool on the left; a beach parking lot on the right; more houses and a mid-rise building across the road behind. People are absent or too small to recognize; no plate, sign or building name is readable.
photos.caption: Four oceanfront houses in Surfside Beach, each with its own pool behind the dunes, seen from a plane in 2011.
photos.alt: Four beach houses in a row, each with a small fenced pool between the house and the dunes, with wooden walkways over the dunes to the beach

place.sublocation: The oceanfront of the Town of Surfside Beach (Horry County tax district 660)

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (3008 x 1960) and as the 1440 x 810 crop by the writer on 2026-11-08. The verifier placed the shore behind frames up to 175738d inside the Town of Surfside Beach (Census geocoder, VERIFY.md Photos). Horry County parcels layer 24, queried 2026-11-08 over -78.9665 33.6125 to -78.9585 33.6185: 463 parcels, all but 84 in tax district 660 (Town of Surfside Beach); land use 100 and 101 (houses) and 107 (condo regimes). The caption names no house and says only that the four houses each have a pool, which the photo shows. No sign, house number or plate is legible at page size; no person is the subject.
